description.value: Rainbow Gas Bar & Convenience is a combined fuel station and convenience store located in the Cariboo, Chilcotin & Central Interior region of BC. Positioned in a remote part of the province, it represents one of the few resupply points touring cyclists might encounter on a long stretch of road. The gas bar component suggests this is a full-service roadside stop rather than a standalone shop.
